# Conseil & Ned Land

- [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) — Comrade of — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) — fellow prisoners held on board the Nautilus · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P5](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0005), +11 more</sub>
- [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) — Friend of — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) — cabin mates and friends on board the Nautilus · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P0](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P16](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0016), +7 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> On board the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), the crew and Captain [Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) eagerly search for the sea monster, joined by the expert Canadian harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). While sitting together on the poop deck, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) debates the monster's existence with [Ned](../character/ned-land.md), using scientific calculations of deep-sea pressure to persuade the skeptical harpooner.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV NED LAND

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P13](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)_

> [The Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) sails around [Cape Horn](../codex/places.md#cape-horn) and searches the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean for months without finding the creature, causing the crew's excitement to turn into frustration. [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) agrees to turn back if the monster is not sighted within three days. On the final evening of the deadline, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) spots the target in the darkness.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P18](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P33](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0033)_

> After falling into the sea, the narrator is rescued by [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and together they keep afloat until they discover [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) standing on a hard structure. They realize the presumed sea monster is actually a metallic submarine vessel, onto which they climb before being pulled inside by masked men at dawn.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P6](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P47](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P58](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P67](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0067)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) are locked in a dark room inside the mysterious submarine vessel. Electric light is switched on, and two unidentified men enter, but they cannot communicate because the prisoners speak French, English, German, and Latin to no avail. After the strangers leave, a steward brings them clothes and a meal before the three men fall asleep.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P14](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P30](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P46](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0046)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) awakens in the cell feeling oxygen-deprived until fresh sea air is pumped in as the vessel surfaces to breathe. [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) awaken shortly after, and as hours pass without food, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) loses his temper. When the steward finally opens the door, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) attacks and throttles him until a voice speaks in French.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P3](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P6](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P20](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P24](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0024)_

> Captain Nemo reveals his identity and informs [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) that they will remain prisoners on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) forever, granted freedom only within the ship. After [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) are dismissed to their cabin, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to breakfast on marine dishes and explains his deep love for the sea. Afterwards, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) begins showing [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) around the vessel, starting with its extensive library.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P40](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P58](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P71](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0071)_

> Captain Nemo shows [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) the various instruments and inner workings of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), explaining how electricity powers the vessel, its speed, and its auxiliary boat. They walk through the ship's compartments toward the engine room before returning to the saloon for further technical details.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P0](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P6](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P16](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P31](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0031)_

> Captain Nemo takes the surface bearings before submerged navigation begins and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) examines the route on a chart. [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) join [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) in the saloon just as the wall panels slide back, revealing an illuminated underwater window into the ocean life outside. They spend hours watching the sea creatures before the observation windows close again for the night.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P4](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P28](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P35](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0035)_

> After days of Captain Nemo's absence, Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) receives a note inviting him and his companions on a hunting expedition in the submarine forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island. Over breakfast, Captain Nemo explains the technology—including modified diving apparatus, electric lanterns, and special air-guns—that will allow them to walk and hunt underwater.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P19](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P34](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P46](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0046)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and Captain Nemo don diving suits and equipped air guns in the Nautilus's wardrobe while [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) declines to join. After entering an airlock, the group exits the submarine to walk along the ocean floor, admiring the undersea landscapes and flora as they head toward the submarine forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P6](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P20](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)_

> On the platform of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), Captain Nemo converses with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) about the life and depths of the ocean. The submarine continues its journey across the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), passing Hawaii and the [Marquesas](../codex/places.md#marquesas), until [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) observe a tragically sunken shipwreck through the drawing-room panels.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028)_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) arrives near the island of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), Captain Nemo asks Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) about the fate of La Pérouse's expedition. [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) recounts the historical searches, after which [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) reveals that he discovered the final wreck of the third vessel constructed by the survivors, showing recovered papers belonging to La Pérouse.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P49](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0049)_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates the treacherous [Torres Straits](../codex/places.md#torres-straits), it runs aground near the Island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa). Captain Nemo remains confident that the upcoming full moon tide will free the ship. Taking advantage of the situation, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) obtain permission to take a small boat to the island to hunt for fresh meat.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P16](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P26](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P41](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0041)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) go ashore on the island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa) to harvest wild plant foods like breadfruit and coconuts. The following day, they return to hunt game, successfully acquiring pigeons, a bird of paradise, a wild hog, and several kangaroos. As they enjoy an elaborate dinner on the beach, their discussion of escaping the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is interrupted by a falling stone.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P20](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P39](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P70](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P78](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0078)_

> Fleeing an attack by [Papuan](../codex/places.md#papua) islanders, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) retreat to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Captain Nemo remains unconcerned by the surrounding natives, spending time discussing explorer [Dumont](../character/urville.md) d'Urville with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) while assuring him the submarine will refloat safely at high tide. As the promised moment approaches, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) orders the hatches opened despite the swarm of natives outside.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P8](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P22](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P70](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P87](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0087)_

> As high tide approaches, Captain Nemo opens the hatches, defying the [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans) waiting outside. The natives, along with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), are repelled by an electrified railing charged by Nemo's power source. Protected by the electric barrier, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) safely floats free from the coral reef at the exact predicted moment.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P98](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0098), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P99](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0099), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P103](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0103), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P105](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0105)_

> While observing the horizon, Captain Nemo spots something alarming and abruptly orders [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) to be locked away in their cell. Soon after eating a provided meal, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) realizes the food was drugged with a soporific, causing all three men to fall into a heavy sleep.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA”

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P21](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P24](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P28](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P43](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0043)_

> Captain Nemo calls upon [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to examine a fatally injured crew member who dies shortly after. The following morning, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) leads [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) on an underwater excursion to bury the deceased sailor in a coral cemetery.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P8](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P23](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P29](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P52](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0052)_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Indian Ocean](../codex/places.md#indian-ocean), the narrator reflects on Captain Nemo's mysterious and vengeful nature. The narrator and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) observe various marine life, including a shoal of argonauts and a milk sea phenomenon, while [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) is eager to harpoon the aggressive sharks surrounding the vessel.
>
> — v2 · PART TWO

_Sources: [v2 PART TWO P2](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0002), [v2 PART TWO P6](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0006), [v2 PART TWO P21](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0021), [v2 PART TWO P25](../source/v02-c00.md#nw-v02-c00-p0025)_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) approaches [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon), Captain Nemo invites [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and his companions to visit the pearl fisheries, casually mentioning the danger of sharks. [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) nervously discusses the offer with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), explaining how pearls are formed and harvested before revealing that they may encounter sharks in the water.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P2](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P20](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0020), [v2 CHAPTER II A NOVEL PROPOSAL OF CAPTAIN NEMO’S P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)_

> Captain Nemo leads [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) on a diving excursion off the coast of [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon) to explore the pearl oyster banks, where they discover a giant tridacne oyster harboring an enormous pearl. While observing an Indian pearl diver, a shark attacks the fisherman. Captain Nemo and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) battle and kill the shark, saving the diver from death.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P25](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0025), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P31](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0031), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P40](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0040), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P46](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0046)_

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) saves Captain Nemo from a fierce shark attack, and [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) subsequently rescues the Cingalese pearl diver. After reviving the diver and gifting him a bag of pearls, the group returns to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) where [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) acknowledges Ned's help and expresses his sympathy for oppressed peoples.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P46](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0046), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P48](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0048), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P51](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0051), [v2 CHAPTER III A PEARL OF TEN MILLIONS P64](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0064)_

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) spots a massive dugong, and Captain Nemo allows him to hunt it from a small boat. After a fierce battle where the creature turns on the boat, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) kills it and it is brought aboard. Later, near [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez), Captain Nemo takes the helm and guides the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) through a subterranean passage under the Isthmus of [Suez](../codex/places.md#suez) into the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean).
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P10](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0010), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041), [v2 CHAPTER V THE ARABIAN TUNNEL P63](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0063)_

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discusses escape plans with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) now that the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) has entered European waters in the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean). Later, off [Crete](../codex/places.md#crete), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) witnesses Captain Nemo send a massive chest of gold to a Greek diver named Pesca. Continuing their journey near [Santorin](../codex/places.md#santorin), Captain Nemo shows [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) a boiling submarine volcanic eruption before steering the vessel back into cooler waters.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VI THE GRECIAN ARCHIPELAGO

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels through the [Mediterranean](../codex/places.md#mediterranean) Sea at high speed, making escape impossible for [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) discuss geology and the eventual cooling of the Earth while navigating a shallow underwater ridge. On February 18th, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) passes through the Straits of [Gibraltar](../codex/places.md#gibraltar) and enters the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) Ocean.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P1](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0001), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 CHAPTER VII THE MEDITERRANEAN IN FORTY-EIGHT HOURS P25](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0025)_

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) informs [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) that he plans to escape from the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) that night as they pass near the Spanish coast. [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) nervously prepares for the escape, but before he can execute the plan, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) stops in [Vigo Bay](../codex/places.md#vigo-bay) and Captain Nemo interrupts him to recount the history of the sunken Spanish galleons while his crew harvests their treasure.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P50](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0050)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) discuss their failed escape attempt and the Nautilus's current southward position. Later that night, Captain Nemo invites [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) on an underwater night excursion without lamps, guided by a glowing light in the distance. They trek across the ocean floor and climb an underwater volcano, revealing the sunken ruins of [Atlantis](../codex/places.md#atlantis).
>

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) docks inside an extinct underwater volcano where Captain Nemo harvests sodium from coal deposits. Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) explore the volcano's subterranean interior, gathering honey, game, and plants before returning to the vessel.
>

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P14](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0014), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P16](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0016), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P27](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0027)_

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) discuss the potential crew size of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), highlighting Ned's growing frustration with his captivity. Later, when the vessel encounters a pod of whales, Captain Nemo refuses to allow [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) to hunt them, but instead uses the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to violently slaughter a attacking pack of aggressive cachalots.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P17](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0017), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P54](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0054), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P64](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0064)_

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates through the treacherous [Antarctic](../codex/places.md#antarctic) ice pack until it becomes completely blocked by an immense iceberg barrier. Captain Nemo proposes diving under the ice fields to reach the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole), and after discussing the logistics with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), he prepares the vessel and dives into the ocean depths to continue the journey south.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P2](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P4](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0004), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P12](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0012), [v2 CHAPTER XIII THE ICEBERG P35](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0035)_

> On March 21st, Captain Nemo and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) climb a volcanic peak on land to observe the sun during the equinox. Using their instruments and chronometer at precisely noon, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) confirms that they have reached the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole) and claims possession of the region under his own name.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIV THE SOUTH POLE

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) collides with an overturned iceberg and is tipped onto its side beneath the ice. Captain Nemo manages to right the vessel, but as they attempt to navigate out of the ice tunnel, both the forward and rear exits are blocked by shifting icebergs, trapping the ship completely.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT?

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P23](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042), [v2 CHAPTER XV ACCIDENT OR INCIDENT? P60](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0060)_

> Trapped in an iceberg with rapidly depleting oxygen, Captain Nemo and the crew work tirelessly to dig through the surrounding ice walls. Facing the additional threat of the surrounding water freezing around them, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) uses boiling water to prevent solidification and ultimately uses the weight of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) to break through the final ice barrier into open water.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P14](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0014), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P18](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0018), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P34](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0034), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P44](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0044)_

> Suffocating from lack of air, the crew and passengers endure extreme agony while Captain Nemo uses the Nautilus's weight and rams to break through the remaining ice. [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) save [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) by giving him their last saved air. Finally, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) breaches the ice surface, allowing fresh air to pour into the vessel.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P44](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0044), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P46](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0046), [v2 CHAPTER XVI WANT OF AIR P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

> After escaping the ice, the passengers revive in the fresh air on the platform and realize the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is heading north through the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic). They continue past the coasts of South [America](../codex/places.md#america), collecting marine specimens along the way. [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) gets shocked when he grabs an electric ray, and the narrative details the various sea life encountered.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XVII FROM CAPE HORN TO THE AMAZON P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_

> While discussing legends and facts about giant cuttlefish, the passengers observe enormous poulps attacking the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). When a creature gets caught in the propeller, Captain Nemo leads the crew onto the deck to fight the monsters, resulting in the loss of a French crewman before the creatures are repelled.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P38](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0038), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P50](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0050), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P58](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0058), [v2 CHAPTER XVIII THE POULPS P61](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0061)_

> [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) pressures [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to ask Captain Nemo for their freedom as the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) sails along the [American](../codex/factions.md#american) coast near the [Gulf Stream](../codex/places.md#gulf-stream). [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) confronts [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) in his room, but [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) firmly rejects releasing them, declaring they must remain on board forever. Afterward, as the vessel reaches [Long Island](../codex/places.md#long-island), [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) deliberately stays at the surface to brave a violent hurricane before finally submerging into the deep.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P27](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0027), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P28](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0028), [v2 CHAPTER XIX THE GULF STREAM P39](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0039)_

> [The Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) travels eastward across the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic), following the route of the transatlantic telegraph cable near [Ireland](../codex/places.md#ireland). It then turns south towards European waters while Captain Nemo searches for a precise location in the sea. Upon reaching the exact spot, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) submerges the vessel to reveal the historic underwater wreck of the French ship 'Le Vengeur'.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P6](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0006), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P9](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0009), [v2 CHAPTER XX FROM LATITUDE 47° 24′ TO LONGITUDE 17° 28′ P14](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0014)_

> An unknown warship fires on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), prompting Captain Nemo to raise his black flag and declare his intent to sink the vessel in revenge. Despite [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) Land's hopes to escape to the attacking ship, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) submerges the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) and rams the vessel beneath its waterline, leaving the three companions helpless witnesses to its total destruction.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P49](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0049), [v2 CHAPTER XXI A HECATOMB P51](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0051)_

> After days of frantic and isolated travel following the ship's destruction, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) informs the narrator that they are near land and will attempt their escape that night. As the narrator creeps past Captain Nemo playing the organ in the dark saloon, he hears [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) mournfully weeping. They join [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) in the small attached boat, but as [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) unbolts it, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) enters the deadly Norwegian maelstrom, ripping the small boat free and knocking the narrator unconscious.
>
> — v2 · CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P23](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P33](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0033), [v2 CHAPTER XXII THE LAST WORDS OF CAPTAIN NEMO P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039)_

> After escaping the maelstrom, Pierre [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) regains consciousness in a fisherman's hut in the Lofoten Isles alongside [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). While awaiting transport to return to [France](../codex/places.md#france), [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) reflects on his ten-month underwater journey, revises his manuscript, and wonders about the ultimate fate of Captain Nemo and the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).
>
